arguments.message: The bug in debounce.ts was that when a new call arrived while a timer was still pending, the function returned early without cancelling the pending setTimeout. This meant fn would still fire after waitMs even though a newer call was made, defeating debounce. The corrected version cancels the pending call (clearTimeout + reset timer), reschedules with the latest arguments using spread (...args), and passes them to fn. The self-test verifies that a second call cancels the pending call and reschedules with latest args. Verification: node debounce.ts printed "all tests passed".
